documents.title: Partner Platform
evidence: Developers create and publish an app on the Partner Platform.
Sellers authorize the app before it manages products and orders.

documents.title: Product Publishing API V3 Integration Guide

required_common_parameters.access_token: Secure token issued for access control after seller authorization
required_common_parameters.timestamp: Ten-digit Unix time in seconds, accepted from 300 seconds before to 300 seconds after the current time

optional_common_parameters.version: API version; the official method page states that V1 is the default when a version is not required

signature_boundary.implementation_rule: A live request is rejected locally unless an approved signature provider for the authorized Partner app is configured.
signature_boundary.secret_rule: Application secrets and access tokens are read only from local runtime configuration and are excluded from payload previews, logs, diagnostics, and source control.

category_input.behavior: The V3 service recommends a Temu category from the external category name, so the V3 guide says bg.local.goods.cats.get is not required for this flow.

attributes.behavior: The V3 service maps external attribute names and values; the guide says the older attribute-template endpoints are not required for this flow.

request_root.goodsBasic: Required basic product object on the method page
request_root.skuList: Required SKU array with at least one item and at most 500 items

goodsBasic.goodsCarouselImage.transport: Public image URLs are downloaded and stored by Temu.

goodsBasic.detailImage.transport: Public image URLs are downloaded and stored by Temu.

skuList[].images.transport: Public image URLs are downloaded and stored by Temu.

skuList[].price.site_specific_rule: Currency, precision, and minimum or maximum amount must meet the destination site's requirements.

product_publish.creation_semantics: A returned goodsId confirms product creation only; it does not confirm that publication requirements are satisfied.

idempotency.rule: The workbench must persist both external identifiers before submission and must block reuse within the same store.

known_processing_statuses.Draft: Product information is incomplete and cannot be submitted for publication.
known_processing_statuses.Incomplete: Product information is complete, has been automatically submitted for review, and is waiting for the platform review result.

status_query.operator_rule: Keep the submission pending until an official status-query response is recorded; do not equate request success with publication.
